title: Dexcom Clarity Uploader
symptom: When using upload to Dexcom servers it works with Dexcom Follow mobile app, but no data are visible in Clarity web app.
cause: xDrip+ does not send data to Dexcom Clarity; Dexcom has no public API for writing data to Clarity and locks the API to its own apps, so implementing the feature is not possible without reverse engineering.
evidence_quote: Dexcom has no public API for writing data to Clarity. Obviously, there is good API but locked for their own apps.
